# Sorleed UI — FinTech Design System & Component Library

> Production-tested React and CSS components for financial, banking, and wealth interfaces. Built with pure design tokens, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, and zero runtime lock-in.

## Core Documentation
- [Overview](https://sorleed.com/docs.html): Architecture, principles, and philosophy.
- [Sorleed CLI](https://sorleed.com/cli.html): Command-line tool to add standalone components directly into any repository.
- [Design Tokens](https://sorleed.com/tokens.html): Foundation colors, spacing, typography, and contrast tokens.
- [Accessibility](https://sorleed.com/accessibility.html): WCAG 2.2 AA compliance standards and verification.

## Quick Installation
```bash
# Copy individual component source into your project
npx @sorleed/cli add balance-card

# Or install the complete React package
npm install @sorleed/react
```
